# Regression test for ICE in SIMD lowering of methods on named struct types.

[!GOEXPERIMENT:simd] skip

go tool compile -p example -I ${GOROOT}/pkg/${GOOS}_${GOARCH} -o out.o method.go
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- method.go --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package example

import "simd"

type Implementation struct{}

func (Implementation) Foo(x []float64) {
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(x[_i:])
		_ = _v1
		_i += _n
	}
}

func (impl Implementation) Bar(x []float32) {
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
		_ = _v1
		_i += _n
	}
}
